name: bootproof
description: The honest run button for repos. Boots unfamiliar code when it safely can, tells the truth when it cannot, and signs proof of what happened.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run build && npm run pack:check && npm publish --dry-run
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/unit.test.mjs tests/action.test.mjs tests/e2e.test.mjs tests/receipt.test.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run test
